outlook.statement: Focus on strengthening operational excellence, deepening engineering capabilities, continued digitalisation, and disciplined investment in product development for evolving automotive industry needs, including EVs and premium vehicle platforms.

Indian automotive industry demonstrated resilience; demand recovered after GST rate rationalisation in September 2025, resulting in strong festive season and record year for auto component industry surpassing Rs 7.6 lakh crore turnover.
The Company is currently profitable and the Board expects this trend to continue in the coming years.
The Company expects that productivity and profitability may improve and would be comparable with the industry average.
The Company endeavors to spend the budgeted CSR expenditure in accordance with statutory requirements for subsequent years.
Another 7 major automation projects are in pipeline and will be achieved very soon.
Working towards introduction & implementation of Material Flow Cost Accounting.
Second Auto Valve counting machine for Honda & Maruti segment will be launched by June 2026 end.

The Indian auto component industry is expected to continue benefiting from strong policy support, improving domestic demand, increasing localisation, and growing integration with global supply chains. The shift towards electric mobility is expected to reduce dependence on certain conventional ICE-related components over the medium to long term. Manufacturers are accelerating investments in EV-compatible components, battery management systems, power electronics, lightweight materials, telematics, and advanced safety technologies.
Efforts will be focused on catering the requirement of our existing customers for their new models and indigenization of various components.
Energy saving through Heat pump; Online Energy Monitoring; Energy saving after energy audit finding.
